name: zclass_cls_di_segment_recursive

known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this recursive helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass cls_di source-cluster pass.

functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x445a00 validates the depth/point-candidate bbox gate, point-candidate append path, animate saved-parent matrix push, animated transform multiply, face-region append dispatch, break-on-first test, listB child recursion through BuildPickCandidatesForSegmentChildFallback, optional matrix pop, and clean EAX candidate-missing return.

The native cls_di smoke verifies animate-node dispatch through the child fallback, matrix-stack restoration, candidate append/count/cursor behavior, and child recursion through the single-segment dispatch group.
